title: Klint Kubiak wants Maxx Crosby to be part of Raiders' success: 'That's a no-brainer'

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Klint Kubiak wants Maxx Crosby to be part of Raiders' success: 'That's a no-brainer'
sources.description: Although Crosby signed a lucrative, three-year extension with the team in 2025, he wasn't happy with how the last regime handled his recent knee injury.
